Class XylemHydraulicCavitationEngine

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.engine.AbstractSimulationEngine
org.ether.society.engines.tier1.XylemHydraulicCavitationEngine
All Implemented Interfaces:
SimulationEngineModule
public class XylemHydraulicCavitationEngine extends AbstractSimulationEngine
Plant Xylem Hydraulic Cavitation invalid input: '&' Runaway Embolism Engine.

Formalizes the biophysical principles of vascular plant water transport and drought-induced hydraulic failure established by Tyree & Sperry (1989), Choat et al. (2012, Nature), and McDowell et al. (2008).

Key Biophysical Mechanics:

  1. Vulnerability Curve (Weibull / Logistic): \[ \text{PLC}(\Psi_{\text{soil}}) = \frac{100.0}{1.0 + \left(\frac{|\Psi_{\text{soil}}|}{|\Psi_{50}|}\right)^a} \] where \(\text{PLC}\) is the Percentage Loss of Hydraulic Conductivity (\(\%\)), \(\Psi_{50}\) is the species/biome-specific water potential causing \(50\%\) embolism in \(\text{MPa}\), and \(a \approx 3.5\) is the steepness shape parameter.
  2. Soil Matric Potential Coupling (Campbell 1974 / van Genuchten 1980): \[ \Psi_{\text{soil}}(S_w) = -\Psi_e \cdot S_w^{-b} \quad [\text{MPa}] \] linking relative soil moisture saturation \(S_w \in (0, 1]\) to suction potential.
  3. Runaway Cavitation & Sudden Canopy Dieback: When \(\text{PLC} > 60\%\), xylem tension causes irreversible air bubble seeding (embolism), choking transpiration and driving quadratic agricultural harvest loss and forest tree mortality: \[ \mu_{\text{dieback}} = \mu_{\max} \cdot \left(\frac{\max(0, \text{PLC} - 50.0)}{50.0}\right)^2 \]

    • estimateSoilWaterPotentialMPa

      public static double estimateSoilWaterPotentialMPa(double moistureFraction)
      Estimates soil matric water potential \(\Psi_{\text{soil}}\) in \(\text{MPa}\) from soil water saturation.
      Parameters:
      moistureFraction - relative soil moisture saturation \(S_w \in [0.01, 1.0]\)
      Returns:
      negative soil water potential in \(\text{MPa}\) (e.g. \(-0.05\text{ MPa}\) wet, \(-4.0\text{ MPa}\) arid)

    • calculatePLC

      public static double calculatePLC(double psiSoilMPa, double psi50MPa, double slope)
      Calculates the Percentage Loss of Xylem Hydraulic Conductivity (\(\text{PLC}\)): \[ \text{PLC} = \frac{100.0}{1.0 + \left(\frac{|\Psi_{\text{soil}}|}{|\Psi_{50}|}\right)^a} \]
      Parameters:
      psiSoilMPa - soil matric water potential in \(\text{MPa}\) (negative)
      psi50MPa - critical water potential causing 50% loss of conductivity in \(\text{MPa}\) (negative)
      slope - curve steepness exponent \(a\)
      Returns:
      percentage loss of conductivity in \([0.0, 100.0]\%\)
